# Bidsketch

Bidsketch is a proposal software that helps businesses create professional proposals quickly and efficiently.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/bidsketch/.

## Actions

- **Get Client** (read-only): Get a client by id.
- **Create Client**: Create a client.
- **Create Fee**: Create a fee.
- **Create Proposal Fee**: Create a proposal fee.
- **Create Proposal Section**: Create a proposal section.
- **Create Section**: Create a section.
- **Create Webhook**: Create a webhook.
- **Delete Client**: Delete a client and all their proposals.
- **Delete Fee**: Delete a fee.
- **Delete Proposal**: Delete a proposal and all its content.
- **Delete Proposal Fee**: Delete a proposal fee.
- **Delete Proposal Section**: Delete a proposal section.
- **Delete Section**: Delete a section.
- **Delete Webhook**: Delete a webhook.
- **Get Client Proposals**: List proposals for a specific client.
- **Get Clients**: Retrieve all clients.
- **Get Fee**: Get a single fee.
- **Get Fees**: List all the fees for the account.
- **Get Proposal**: Get a proposal by id.
- **Get Proposal Content**: Get a proposal with all its content (sections and fees).
- **Get Proposal Fee**: Get a single fee item for a proposal.
- **Get Proposal Fees**: List all fees for a proposal.
- **Get Proposal Section**: Fetch a single proposal section.
- **Get Proposal Sections**: Get all sections for a proposal.
- **Get Proposal Stats**: Get proposal statistics.
- **Get Proposals**: Retrieve all proposals for the account.
- **Get Section**: Fetch a section by id.
- **Get Sections**: List all sections.
- **Get Templates**: List all proposal templates saved for the account.
- **Update Client**: Update a client.
- **Update Fee**: Update a fee.
- **Update Proposal**: Update a specific proposal's details.
- **Update Proposal Fee**: Update a proposal fee.
- **Update Proposal Section**: Update a proposal section.
- **Update Section**: Update a section.
